title: SYNAPSE: Sharing Tool-Use Experience Across Organizations with Differential Privacy
abstract: arXiv:2602.00911v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: An agent with a large tool catalog first retrieves a few candidate tools for each request. Examples of how people used each tool help this step, but usage records are private and stay with the organizations that hold them. We present SYNAPSE, a way for organizations to share tool-use experience without sharing records. They jointly train a request generator under differential privacy (DP) and release noisy per-tool usage counts, which set how many requests the generator writes for each tool. The generated requests become each tool's usage field in a shared index, scored beside public documentation. For fixed scoring settings, each release is record-level DP if its noise stays secret, at least three of five clients are honest and secure aggregation holds; choosing the settings on a second release doubles the budget. translated_title: SYNAPSE：基于差分隐私的跨组织工具使用经验共享
translated_abstract: 拥有大型工具目录的智能体在处理每个请求时，首先会检索出若干候选工具。人们使用每个工具的实际示例有助于这一步骤，但使用记录是私密的，并保留在持有这些记录的组织内部。我们提出了SYNAPSE，这是一种让组织在不共享记录的前提下共享工具使用经验的方法。各组织在差分隐私（DP）保护下联合训练一个请求生成器，并发布加噪的每工具使用计数，这些计数决定了生成器为每个工具生成多少条请求。生成的请求成为共享索引中每个工具的“使用”字段，并与公开文档一同参与评分。在评分设置固定的情况下，只要噪声保持保密、五个客户端中至少三个是诚实的，且安全聚合成立，每次发布即满足记录级差分隐私；若在第二次发布时选择评分设置，则隐私预算翻倍。我们的基准测试以公开噪声和从同一池中抽取的五个客户端来模拟该机制，因此它衡量的是效用而非隐私……
tldr: 提出SYNAPSE框架，使各组织能在差分隐私保护下联合训练请求生成器并发布加噪的工具使用计数，在不泄露私密使用记录的情况下跨组织共享工具使用经验，从而提升智能体的工具检索效果。
en_tdlr: SYNAPSE enables organizations to share tool-use experience without exposing private records by jointly training a request generator under differential privacy and releasing noisy per-tool usage counts that build a shared index improving agent tool retrieval.
